neighbours.label: function word or comma just before an Italian city name (to Florence, at Padua, in Florence, on Rome)
fire: Buses run every fifteen minutes to Pisa, and then a good train service to Florence.
He carried out important building works at Arezzo, Montefiascone, Florence and Rome.
In 1922 a column of Fascists marched on Rome led by their generals.
He built an astronomical clock in the facade of the palace at Padua.
The family agreed that the works of art should always remain in Florence.
The Medici bank had branches in Venice, Milan and Naples.
After the plague, the painter moved from Siena to Florence.
The pope fled from Rome to Avignon during the crisis.

notes: Peaks on the token preceding Florence/Rome/Padua/Montefiascone in Italian-history or travel prose; a prediction of an Italian place name. + pole is a similar Italian-geography context.
